attempts.summary: Installed a root crontab entry on node1 that runs /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending stdout/stderr to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Verified the command executes correctly and writes to the log. Performed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id and service/data state, issued a native reboot (shutdown -r now) whose acknowledgement returned before disconnection, polled until node1 was reachable again, and confirmed the boot_id changed (8336c3a1... -> bb225e25...) along with recovered cron service (active), persisted root crontab entry, and intact log file/content post-restart.
